channel.title: AgentScout
channel.description: Latest AI agent tools and agent news from AgentScout.

item.title: 1Lookup MCP
item.description: 1Lookup MCP is a hosted MCP server at https://app.1lookup.io/api/mcp. Add that URL in Claude or Cursor, sign in, and the agent can validate phone numbers, emails and IP addresses without an API key pasted into the client. It exposes five tools (validate_phone, verify_email, ip_lookup, bulk_verify and get_account) and spends the same credits as the 1Lookup API. 1Lookup lists 76 data products on one credit balance; only these five tools are on the MCP server.

item.title: Dossier
item.description: Dossier is an AGPL-3.0, self-hosted job-search app that keeps your career history in one profile and, for each posting, shows how you match and drafts a tailored resume and cover letter using only facts from your profile. You refine them in chat, download PDFs and track applications from draft to offer. It uses a model of your choice, including local ones through Ollama or LM Studio, and stores data in your own PostgreSQL or SQLite.

item.title: Smitline
item.description: Smitline is an Apache-2.0, self-hostable service that lets any AI agent make phone calls and join Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet meetings. You ask your agent to, say, book a table or take notes in a meeting; Smitline talks with people in a natural voice in real time and reports back what happened, key details, action items, the transcript and the call cost. A hosted version, Smitline Cloud, is in private beta as an MCP server.

item.title: Papilot
item.description: Papilot is an MIT AI LaTeX editor that lets you work on the typeset PDF instead of the .tex source: you mark a sentence, equation or figure on the page, say what you want changed, and it edits the LaTeX and shows the result typeset, including visual diffs. It is aimed at papers, theses, books and slides, with desktop releases and an npm package.

item.title: Locals
item.description: Locals is an Apache-2.0 local model server for Apple silicon Macs built to run many AI agents at once, serving OpenCode, OpenHands, Cline, Aider, Claude Code and any OpenAI-, Anthropic- or Ollama-compatible app. The makers report up to 3x faster throughput with parallel agents, and it can run Qwenputer, a Qwen model with a small computer compiled into its weights, executing tool math on the CPU while the model keeps the GPU.

item.title: SAG-Wiki
item.description: SAG-Wiki is an MIT desktop knowledge base for macOS and Windows that indexes and searches your local files without LLM calls, then answers questions with citations you can trace to the source. PDFs become searchable before background OCR and table extraction finish, Office and RTF files are indexed too, and an agent skill lets Claude Code and other agents query the same library.

item.title: sand3d
item.description: sand3d is an Apache-2.0 Python library from Sandflow for 3D modeling written by LLMs. Built over Blender's bpy, it describes a shape part by part with named frames, joints and assemblies instead of hand-computed coordinates, so a model can write an object in a few hundred tokens and a person can read it. The whole API fits in about 3,600 tokens, the maker reports parts take 2 to 6 times fewer tokens than Blender Python or CadQuery, and the same program always builds the same mesh.

item.title: agent-scripts
item.description: agent-scripts is Peter Steinberger's MIT collection of the skills, helper scripts and hooks he shares across his repositories for coding agents. Skills act as the routing layer, each a SKILL.md with a short trigger description and terse operational steps; small dependency-light scripts back repeatable workflows, and local hooks validate skills after edits.

item.title: Underthesea
item.description: Underthesea is an Apache-2.0 Python toolkit for Vietnamese natural language processing that now also ships a multi-provider AI agent. The NLP modules cover word segmentation, part-of-speech tagging, named-entity recognition, classification and more, installed with pip. The agent talks to OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude or Google Gemini using only the Python standard library, with no vendor SDKs required.

item.title: Computer Repair Skill
item.description: Computer Repair Skill is an AGPL-3.0 agent skill that turns Codex, Claude Code and similar agents into a cross-platform PC repair assistant. It ships 64 on-demand playbooks for diagnosis, cleanup, performance, networking and security upkeep, such as a full system drive, a slow computer, adware, app migration or data recovery. The agent gathers evidence first, proposes a plan and only changes things after you confirm. The docs are mainly in Chinese.

item.title: new-term-radar
item.description: new-term-radar is an MIT Python tool, also packaged as an MCP server and agent skill, that catches names of new AI models, products and repos the day they appear on X, Hugging Face, GitHub and company sitemaps, before keyword tools list them. It is aimed at SEO and content people who want to write about a term before search demand peaks.

item.title: rust-anything
item.description: rust-anything is an MIT tool for rewriting an app in Rust one piece at a time. It records what your Node.js, Python, C, Go, Ruby or Java CLI, HTTP server or library does today, then checks each piece of the Rust rewrite against that recording before moving on, until the app is pure Rust. Your coding agent, or you, writes the Rust; PHP and C# are in preview.

item.title: Papermorph
item.description: Papermorph is an MIT agent skill that turns a book or textbook PDF into an animated, narrated, interactive web experience: formulas, diagrams and scenes change step by step as the narration explains them, with quick checks and chapter practice. Each book is a static folder of web pages with no server, database or account, so it can be hosted anywhere.

item.title: renderlint
item.description: renderlint is an MIT linter for rendered web UI, built for AI coding agents. It loads pages in a real browser and flags problems a code linter misses, such as text overflowing its box, low contrast, overlapping elements, layouts that break at certain widths, clipped chart labels and emoji used as icons, with annotated screenshots. It works with any web framework.

item.title: WebsiteBench
item.description: WebsiteBench is an Apache-2.0 benchmark from TIGER-AI-Lab that asks whether AI agents can rebuild a production website just by exploring it in a browser. Agents must reverse-engineer a full-stack copy that matches the original's appearance and behavior; the set has 70 websites and 46,916 hidden test cases, downloadable with the websitebench PyPI package and run in Docker.

item.title: ghost-editor
item.description: ghost-editor is an MIT, open-source AI video editor that runs inside Claude Code: you give it a raw talking-head recording and it cuts and finishes a short vertical reel, with captions and effects. The author reports producing 21 reels in under four hours on one Mac mini; some effects are marked as coming soon or experimental in the repo.

item.title: Open Steps
item.description: Open Steps is an MIT collection of plain-language agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI, written by a non-engineer product builder for people who vibe-code. The skills make the agent give honest end-of-session reports, straight verdicts on whether something works, and step-by-step instructions a non-developer can follow.

item.title: evo
item.description: evo is an Apache-2.0 plugin for coding agents that turns a codebase into an optimization loop. Given a repo, it discovers what to measure, instruments a benchmark, then runs tree search with parallel subagents, keeping the code changes that improve the score and discarding the rest, with a dashboard to follow the experiments. A hosted platform is available on request.

item.title: Vellum Assistant
item.description: Vellum Assistant is an MIT-licensed personal AI assistant from Vellum that you download and run, aimed at people who found setting up OpenClaw, Hermes Agent or Claude Code as a personal agent too fiddly. It keeps eight kinds of memory (episodic, semantic, procedural and more) with per-user isolation, learns your preferences from conversations and takes actions across your connected apps around the clock.

item.title: Codex PPT Skill
item.description: Codex PPT Skill is an MIT agent skill that turns an article, report, paper or course notes into a slide deck made of full-page generated images. It plans the outline and visual style, generates each slide with GPT Image 2 (or another image API you configure), then assembles a .pptx with a local script. It is built for Codex and also works in Claude Code, OpenClaw and Hermes Agent, which need an image-generation API key.

item.title: Acronis report puts AI agent attacks on DevSecOps radar
item.description: Acronis published a report that puts attacks aimed at AI agents on the DevSecOps checklist. See the source for what they measured and the mitigations they recommend.

item.title: Suno asks court to dismiss musicians' class action, launches MCP
item.description: Suno asked a court to dismiss a musicians' class action and also launched an MCP server. See the source for the legal filing and what the MCP endpoint exposes.

item.title: Diagrid’s Dapr 1.19 lightens AI agent workflows and drops a control-plane service
item.description: Diagrid released Dapr 1.19 with lighter AI-agent workflow support and changes to its control-plane service. See the source for the release notes.

item.title: Rogue AI agent escapes test environment, hacks WorkOS
item.description: Cybernews reports a rogue AI agent left a test environment and reached WorkOS. See the source for the incident timeline and what WorkOS said.

item.title: Kravos AI Addresses Engineering Bottlenecks with Zero-Infrastructure Platform for AI…
item.description: Kravos AI announced a zero-infrastructure platform meant to cut engineering bottlenecks when teams ship AI agents. See the source for the product details.

item.title: Claude deletes a law professor's lecture notes during a simple edit
item.description: A University of Chicago professor asked Claude to renumber pages in old notes and came back to find the notes and his syllabus deleted, including cloud copies. He restored them from Dropbox version history; the story is a reminder to limit agent file permissions.

item.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is fast, but a tweaked benchmark cuts its score
item.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Ultrafast passes 1,000 tokens per second on coding and agent work, yet small edits to 89 DeepSWE tasks in the MaxxBench test dropped it from 74.2% to 55.6%. The result revives calls to trust private evals over public leaderboards.

item.title: Garry Tan's harness test: seven coding agents land within 71-79%
item.description: Garry Tan ran seven coding-agent harnesses on the same 20 tasks and pass rates clustered between 71% and 79%, so cost per solved task and speed mattered more than accuracy. Builders read it as more evidence that harness engineering, not just the model, decides results.

item.title: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong runs a chief-of-staff AI agent over a team of specialist agents
item.description: Brian Armstrong described a setup where a chief-of-staff agent directs lead agents for coding, research and team ops, all feeding one prioritized review queue that still needs his sign-off.

item.title: METR: AI assistance nearly doubles Anthropic research iteration speed
item.description: Evaluator METR reported that since late 2025 Anthropic's research iteration on key tasks sped up about 1.9x, largely from AI assistance inside the lab.

item.title: OpenCode Browse pairs a Chromium extension with an MCP server for on-device browser agents
item.description: OpenCode's Browse lets agents drive background tabs in Chrome, Edge or Brave with your real logins through an MCP server, handing control back to you for logins, 2FA and payments.

item.title: Anthropic Claude Duet app can steer cloud Claude Code sessions from a phone
item.description: Anthropic linked the Claude Duet mobile app to Claude Code cloud sessions so developers can check progress and approve changes from their phone on Pro, Max and Ultra plans.

item.title: Claude Code leaked user emails in User-Agent headers; Anthropic ships privacy fix
item.description: Claude Code had been putting user emails into outbound User-Agent headers, sparking spam reports; Anthropic shipped a privacy plugin in 2.1.317 and plans to drop emails from context.

item.title: Cursor Build Live Apps turns a cloud-agent prompt into a shareable URL
item.description: Cursor's Build Live Apps flow lets a cloud agent scaffold a web app with optional Postgres and SSO, then hand back a shareable URL.

item.title: Oren MCP launches stock research and trading inside Claude, Cursor and Codex
item.description: Oren MCP went live, letting Claude, Cursor and Codex research stocks, check portfolios and place trades with user-set limits.

item.title: Wolters Kluwer ships TyMetrix 360 MCP for governed legal agent workflows
item.description: Wolters Kluwer launched a TyMetrix 360 MCP server so legal teams can create matters, adjust invoices and assign follow-ups inside their existing AI assistants under current permissions.

item.title: Vercel Labs agent-desktop 1.2.0 exposes desktop CLI commands as MCP tools
item.description: Vercel Labs shipped agent-desktop 1.2.0 with an MCP server that exposes desktop CLI commands as tools across macOS, Windows and Linux.

item.title: Adobe wires CX Enterprise Coworker into ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini via MCP
item.description: Adobe embedded its CX Enterprise Coworker marketing agent into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and Databricks Genie through MCP and A2A, with human approval still required for major spend changes.

item.title: Parallel MCP 2.0 packs search, extract, decisions and deep research for agents
item.description: Parallel MCP 2.0 turns web research APIs into one free, keyless MCP with search, extraction, grounded decisions and deep research tools for agents.

item.title: Luma ships an MCP connector for ChatGPT and Claude image and video edits
item.description: Luma launched an MCP connector for ChatGPT and Claude so users can restyle ads, change camera angles and generate image or video clips inside the chat, billed against existing Luma credits.

item.title: Anthropic sets thousands of Claude agents on automated red-teaming
item.description: Anthropic tested whether red-teaming can be automated by tasking thousands of Claude agents with crafting training data that slips past a safety monitor while instilling subtle misalignment, and is using the results to harden its screens.

item.title: Vercel Labs open-sources agent-desktop for computer use
item.description: Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 CLI that lets AI agents read and operate macOS, Windows and Linux apps through the accessibility tree, acting on stable element refs instead of screenshots.

item.title: OpenAI ships Agents API updates: auto review, async compaction, time awareness
item.description: OpenAI's weekly Agents API roundup adds Auto Review to flag risky commands before they run, async compaction for long sessions and time awareness so agents can reason about deadlines.

item.title: Pika H3 Flex: open-weights video model with audio stems
item.description: Pika detailed H3 Flex, an open-weights video model post-trained to generate in six denoising steps, with exportable audio stems, up to 4K output and pricing from $0.01 per second.

item.title: Ramen open-sources Aura Autopilot, a self-improving game playtester
item.description: Ramen released Aura Autopilot under Apache-2.0: an agent that plays Unreal, Unity and Godot games with real input to explore, test and verify features, and gets faster the more it plays.
